scenario: The prefix rule (LNUL.11.1) for the run-time spec refusal: `r` logs `before`, then interpolates `{p.body.x:.3f}` on a String leaf, then logs `after`. The refusal abandons the activation at the second action (LGRA.2.9.6.11), so `before` stands, `after` does not run, and `handler` logs: `["before", "type error"]`. PATH PINNED: the refusal raised as the activation's fault from inside the action list, not the message dropped. A runtime that renders the value instead logs `before`, `v abc` and `after`.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    P p
->
    log info "before"
    log info "v {p.body.x:.3f}"
    log info "after"

rule handler:
    TypeError
->
    log info "type error"
